free_tier.stated: Quoted: 'FreeMach™ is a community-powered project that provides free VPS hosting to qualifying applicants of the LowEndSpirit, HostedTalk, and LowEndTalk communities'. Current allocation: 'EU1 (AlphaVPS, Bulgaria): 10/10 VMs Allocated (0 slots free)' and 'US1 (VirMach, New York): 10/10 VMs Allocated (0 slots free)'.

per_object_cap.stated: quoted: '10/10 VMs Allocated (0 slots free)' on both hosts, so there is no free slot to allocate today

retention.stated: not published as a clock; the project states applicants are 'Expected to have a purpose in mind to use the service (no idlers)'

egress.terms: quoted: '1TB @ 1 Gbps' per VM, with '1 IPv4'

interface_detail: a KVM virtual machine with root, one IPv4, on a host donated by AlphaVPS in Sofia or VirMach in New York
chaining: Nothing until a slot frees: both hosts are at 10 of 10.

limits.value: 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, 25 GB SSD on EU1; 2 vCPU, 3 GB RAM, 120 GB HDD on US1
a forum account at least 3 months old, a FraudRecord check, and a human review of the application

binding_note: Capacity is the first wall and reputation is the second: both hosts report 0 of 10 slots free, and the application requires a three-month-old forum account that passes a FraudRecord check.

identity_cost.detail: no card, but a reputation gate: quoted 'Must be an active user of LowEndSpirit, HostedTalk, and/or LowEndTalk communities'; 'LES/HT/LET account must be at least 3 months old at time of application'; 'Must pass a FraudRecord check (Do not use a proxy to submit the application)'. The application is a Google Form.

reliability_note: No reliability event observed. The project publishes a status link to a HetrixTools monitor.
confidence_note: The allocation count, the specification and the eligibility rules are quoted from the project's own page read today. The page is small and the project is one person's, so this is documented about the offer and about the current full capacity.

evidence.proved: quoted: 'EU1 (AlphaVPS, Bulgaria): 10/10 VMs Allocated (0 slots free)', 'US1 (VirMach, New York): 10/10 VMs Allocated (0 slots free)'; 'LES/HT/LET account must be at least 3 months old at time of application'; 'Must pass a FraudRecord check'; specs '2 vCPU', '2GB RAM', '25GB SSD', '1TB @ 1 Gbps', '1 IPv4'

notes: A real project with real sponsors and a real specification, recorded because it is the clearest illustration of why the free-VPS forum layer is not a route for a user: every slot is full, and the door is a three-month-old forum account plus a fraud check. The corpus already carries freevps.org and microlxc on the same reputation model. Nothing here is a defect in the project; it is simply not available to a person who is not already in that community.

extras.price_arithmetic: no charge; the constraint is eligibility and capacity, not price

network_out.ports: 1 IPv4, 1 TB a month at 1 Gbps

session_cap.note: no clock published; 'no idlers' is the stated policy
